With h=2^{k-1}, odd j satisfy (j^h-1)/2^{k+1}=(j^2-1)/8 mod4; even j^n terms vanish at the stated n>=k+3 bound. The weighted functions U_epsilon have Delta^8 U=0 mod4, leaving exact c_0..7=(1,1,2,7,33,197,1419,11966), whose weighted sums are 2 for even n and 0 for odd. This yields half-shift obstruction and a full shift 2^k for all n>=k+3. Since any minimal eventual period divides 2^k and 2^{k-1} fails, it equals 2^k. Independent integer Stirling recurrence checked the period and obstruction for r=5..8; finite checks do not prove all powers.
